Apple Silicon subtitle utility using local Qwen speech recognition and alignment, batch processing, Chinese text correction, translation and simplified/traditional conversion. Includes an unsigned macOS installer; initial model downloads are required. Exact Resolve edition compatibility and repository reuse license are not established.

Apple Silicon subtitle utility with local Qwen recognition/alignment and optional Doubao cloud captions, plus batch processing, Chinese correction and translation. Cloud captions no longer require local Qwen models; local modes still need downloads. The full macOS package is unsigned. Exact Resolve edition compatibility and repository reuse license are not established.

history.name: HooperH/SubFix
history.summary: Moves recognition and alignment models out of the installer and adds a model center with download and offline import. Fixes subtitle imports into busy collaboration bins and constrains recognition to the selected range when timestamps are irregular. Upgrading from 3.3.9 or earlier requires the full package.

history.summary: # SubFix v3.3.2  - 完整窗口右下角显示当前版本号，状态信息不会覆盖版本标签。 - 修复旧版应用内更新时的“更新包包含未授权文件”：默认更新包兼容最早 v3.1.0 的固定文件清单，新更新器优先选择包含 FFmpeg 的完整更新包。 - 保留 v3.3.1 的本地 Qwen 内存保护、进程管理及其他现有功能。  安装更新后请完全退出并重新启动 DaVinci Resolve。  首次安装请下载 `SubFix-v3.3.2-Full-macOS.zip`（Apple Silicon，未签名安装包）；已有用户可点击“检查更新”。
